bootstrap_order: Verify final candidate hashes/signature/dependency closure on all five inactive masked nodes; refuse any unowned native data or existing VM.
Install final signed candidate and exact staged vendor migration together with normal DNF; retain package/proc/runtime manifest receipts.
Render native config from exact installed vendor source using protected local DB secret, selected SERVER_ID and unchanged Raft timing/purge.
Start only rc01 in solo mode to create native schema and server identity; no workloads or automatic recovery hooks.
Capture full generated .one and native DB privately; do not fabricate independent follower authority. Register rc01 as server0 then transition it to HA configuration.

Enroll one inactive follower at a time from a consistent leader DB snapshot and full .one; add exact native server membership, configure returned expected ID, start; verify closing-watermark convergence before next enrollment. Never replay uncertain membership writes.
Verify all five /proc executable digests, Raft reachability/single leader/term and VIP ownership; check private SQL isolation.
Create/read back exactly five native KVM hosts in cluster0, map expected IDs to exact node UUID/IP, keep hosts disabled until source/monitoring/remotes/SSH/NFS checks pass.
Configure retained shared native datastores and exact manual OneDRS policy with K2; generated plans/Apply remain approval-driven.
Install reviewed fence authority/protocol and native host-error hook only after negative verification tests pass; automatic replay remains disabled.
Admit owned canaries and perform explicit measured fault cases; start the required uninterrupted candidate soak only after successful baseline and fault restoration.

candidate.gate: No install/start until all fields are supplied from parent-frozen combined candidate and actual signed RPM closure verifies.

compute.libvirt_transport: Strict realm SSH, no TCP libvirt listener

firewall.apply_scope: new five guests only; no outer/global firewall replacement
firewall.default: DROP ingress, standard established/related and loopback remain

rules.purpose: strict pinned management and native compute SSH

firewall.storage_rule: Existing own storage policy allows TCP2049 only five .247 clientIPs; outer .1 denied.

mariadb.credential_files: root-owned frontend-auth; no password in public proposal

resilience.after_two_fences: DEGRADED: configured N+2 reserve consumed; three healthy voters/compute members may recover only after demonstrable fences. No healthy N+2 claim until measured restoration.
resilience.failure_domain_labels: Five logical owned-node labels for software tests; no physical independence claim.

storage.failure_domain: Single storage VM and same physical outer host: disposable software-fault evidence only.
storage.retained_disks: Never copy or erase native guest disks during a fence/recovery; authoritative same datastore remains mounted on all survivors.

transport: Native XML-RPC/Raft HTTP within exact .247 realm; operator access via strict SSH forward where possible. No native TLS claim.

vip_hooks.readback: Exactly one assigned VIP matching current native leader; direct per-member Raft closing-watermark convergence.
vip_hooks.script: Exact candidate packaged hook, no fabricated leader election
